recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as the disposition for this core-branch reconciliation. If equivalent Java library behavior needs future work, handle it in the maintained Java tooling/library repository rather than by editing current FHIR specification source.
issue_request: FHIR-19646 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core correction for STU3 asking to prevent IG Publisher "Null node type" failures by changing BaseNarrative.java and Narrative.java so new XhtmlNode instances were created with an explicit NodeType.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the issue was applied as 0a27e18 on 2018-11-14. That commit changed the old implementations/java/org.hl7.fhir.r4 model classes to construct Narrative.div with new XhtmlNode(NodeType.Element, "div"), and a2cd914 restored the Narrative.java hunk after a later regeneration.
additional_context: The affected Java implementation source was later moved under implementations/java/old by 5ebfad and the active implementations/java tree, including the R4 BaseNarrative.java, Narrative.java, and XhtmlNode.java paths, was deleted by 7a2c3cd. The current core checkout contains no Java implementation files and source/fhir.ini has no active build reference to those old Java model sources. A bounded Zulip/Confluence search found no directly relevant community record that changes the Jira and git-history conclusion.
reconciliation: No source file was changed in HL7/fhir because the requested Java code no longer exists in the current core source checkout or current build scope. The required durable audit record was published as an empty commit on the combined branch.
